41	// Handles the flow of creating all the pages and resources for all sites.
42	// This includes applying any cascade configuration passed down the tree.
43	type allPagesAssembler struct {
44		// Dependencies.
45		ctx context.Context
46		h   *HugoSites
47		m   *pageMap
48		g   errgroup.Group
49	
50		assembleChanges            *WhatChanged
51		assembleSectionsInParallel bool
52	
53		pwRoot *doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode] // walks pages.
54		rwRoot *doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode] // walks resources.
55	
56		// Walking state.
57		seenTerms        *maphelpers.ConcurrentMap[term, sitesmatrix.Vectors]
58		droppedPages     *maphelpers.ConcurrentMap[*Site, []string] // e.g. drafts, expired, future.

63	func newAllPagesAssembler(
64		ctx context.Context,
65		h *HugoSites,
66		m *pageMap,
67		assembleChanges *WhatChanged,
68	) *allPagesAssembler {
69		rw := &doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode]{
70			Tree:        m.treeResources,
71			LockType:    doctree.LockTypeNone,
72			NoShift:     true,
73			WalkContext: &doctree.WalkContext[contentNode]{},
74		}
75		pw := rw.Extend()
76		pw.Tree = m.treePages
77	
78		seenRootSections := maphelpers.NewConcurrentMap[string, bool]()
79		seenRootSections.Set("", true) // home.
80	
81		return &allPagesAssembler{
82			ctx:                        ctx,
83			h:                          h,
84			m:                          m,
85			assembleChanges:            assembleChanges,
86			seenTerms:                  maphelpers.NewConcurrentMap[term, sitesmatrix.Vectors](),
87			droppedPages:               maphelpers.NewConcurrentMap[*Site, []string](),
88			seenRootSections:           seenRootSections,
89			assembleSectionsInParallel: !h.isRebuild(), // On partial rebuilds, there's potential data races with parallel section assembly.
90			pwRoot:                     pw,
91			rwRoot:                     rw,
92		}
93	}

102	func (a *allPagesAssembler) createAllPages() error {
103		defer func() {
104			for site, dropped := range a.droppedPages.All() {
105				for _, s := range dropped {
106					site.pageMap.treePages.Delete(s)
107					site.pageMap.resourceTrees.DeletePrefix(paths.AddTrailingSlash(s))
108				}
109			}
110		}()
111	
112		if a.h.Conf.Watching() {
113			defer func() {
114				if a.h.isRebuild() && a.h.previousSeenTerms != nil {
115					// Find removed terms.
116					for t := range a.h.previousSeenTerms.All() {
117						if _, found := a.seenTerms.Lookup(t); !found {
118							// This term has been removed.
119							a.pwRoot.Tree.Delete(t.view.pluralTreeKey)
120							a.rwRoot.Tree.DeletePrefix(t.view.pluralTreeKey + "/")
121						}
122					}
123					// Find new terms.
124					for t := range a.seenTerms.All() {
125						if _, found := a.h.previousSeenTerms.Lookup(t); !found {
126							// This term is new.
127							if n, ok := a.pwRoot.Tree.GetRaw(t.view.pluralTreeKey); ok {
128								a.assembleChanges.Add(cnh.GetIdentity(n))
129							}
130						}
131					}
132				}
133				a.h.previousSeenTerms = a.seenTerms
134			}()
135		}
136	
137		if err := cmp.Or(a.doCreatePages("", 0), a.g.Wait()); err != nil {
138			return err
139		}
140		if err := a.pwRoot.WalkContext.HandleEventsAndHooks(); err != nil {
141			return err
142		}
143		return nil
144	}

148			sites     = a.h.sitesVersionsRolesMap

152			getViews = func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector) []viewName {
153				return h.languageSiteForSiteVector(vec).pageMap.cfg.taxonomyConfig.views
154			}
155	
156			pw *doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode] // walks pages.
157			rw *doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode] // walks resources.
158	
159			isRootWalk = depth == 0
160		)
161	
162		if isRootWalk {
163			pw = a.pwRoot
164			rw = a.rwRoot
165		} else {
166			// Sub-walkers for a specific prefix.
167			pw = a.pwRoot.Extend()
168			pw.Prefix = prefix + "/"
169	
170			rw = a.rwRoot.Extend() // rw will get its prefix(es) set later.
171	
172		}

175			n contentNode

177		}{}

204		getCascades := func(wctx *doctree.WalkContext[contentNode], s string) *page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs {
205			if wctx == nil {
206				panic("nil walk context")
207			}
208			var cascades *page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs
209			data := wctx.Data()
210			if s != "" {
211				_, data := data.LongestPrefix(s)
212	
213				if data != nil {
214					cascades = data.(*page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs)
215				}
216			}
217	
218			if cascades == nil {
219				for s := range a.h.allSiteLanguages(nil) {
220					cascades = cascades.Append(s.conf.Cascade)
221				}
222			}
223			return cascades
224		}

226		doTransformPages := func(s string, n contentNode, cascades *page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {
227			defer func() {
228				cascadesLen := cascades.Len()
229				if n2 == nil {
230					if ns < doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip {
231						ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip
232					}
233				} else {
234					n2.forEeachContentNode(
235						func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector, nn contentNode) bool {
236							if pms, ok := nn.(contentNodeCascadeProvider); ok {
237								cascades = cascades.Prepend(pms.getCascade())
238							}
239							return true
240						},
241					)
242				}
243	
244				if s == "" || cascades.Len() > cascadesLen {
245					// New cascade values added, pass them downwards.
246					rw.WalkContext.Data().Insert(paths.AddTrailingSlash(s), cascades)
247				}
248			}()
249	
250			var handlePageMetaSource func(v contentNode, n contentNodesMap, replaceVector bool) (n2 contentNode, err error)
251			handlePageMetaSource = func(v contentNode, n contentNodesMap, replaceVector bool) (n2 contentNode, err error) {
252				if n != nil {
253					n2 = n
254				}
255	
256				switch ms := v.(type) {
257				case *pageMetaSource:
258					if err := ms.initEarly(a.h, cascades); err != nil {
259						return nil, err
260					}
261	
262					sitesMatrix := ms.pageConfigSource.SitesMatrix
263	
264					sitesMatrix.ForEachVector(func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector) bool {
265						site, found := sites[vec]
266						if !found {
267							panic(fmt.Sprintf("site not found for %v", vec))
268						}
269	
270						var p *pageState
271						p, err = site.newPageFromPageMetasource(ms, cascades)
272						if err != nil {
273							return false
274						}
275	
276						if !site.shouldBuild(p) {
277							(&p.m.pageConfig.Build).Disable()
278							switch p.Kind() {
279							case kinds.KindHome, kinds.KindSection, kinds.KindTaxonomy:
280								// We need to keep these for the structure.
281							default:
282								// Drop this page.
283								a.droppedPages.WithWriteLock(
284									func(m map[*Site][]string) error {
285										m[site] = append(m[site], s)
286										return nil
287									},
288								)
289							}
290						}
291	
292						if n == nil {
293							if n2 == nil {
294								// Avoid creating a map for one node.
295								n2 = p
296							} else {
297								// Upgrade to a map.
298								n = make(contentNodesMap)
299								ps := n2.(*pageState)
300								n[ps.s.siteVector] = ps
301								n2 = n
302							}
303						}
304	
305						if n == nil {
306							return true
307						}
308	
309						pp, found := n[vec]
310	
311						var w1, w2 int
312						if wp, ok := pp.(contentNodeContentWeightProvider); ok {
313							w1 = wp.contentWeight()
314						}
315						w2 = p.contentWeight()
316	
317						if found && !replaceVector && w1 > w2 {
318							return true
319						}
320	
321						n[vec] = p
322						return true
323					})
324				case *pageState:
325					if n == nil {
326						n2 = ms
327						return
328					}
329					n[ms.s.siteVector] = ms
330				case contentNodesMap:
331					for _, vv := range ms {
332						var err error
333						n2, err = handlePageMetaSource(vv, n, replaceVector)
334						if err != nil {
335							return nil, err
336						}
337						if m, ok := n2.(contentNodesMap); ok {
338							n = m
339						}
340	
341					}
342				default:
343					panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected type %T", v))
344				}
345	
346				return
347			}
348	
349			// The common case.
350			ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateReplaced
351	
352			handleContentNodeSeq := func(v contentNodeSeq) (contentNode, doctree.NodeTransformState, error) {
353				is := make(contentNodesMap)
354				for ms := range v {
355					_, err := handlePageMetaSource(ms, is, false)
356					if err != nil {
357						return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to create page from pageMetaSource %s: %w", s, err)
358					}
359				}
360				return is, ns, nil
361			}
362	
363			switch v := n.(type) {
364			case contentNodeSeq, contentNodes:
365				return handleContentNodeSeq(cnh.contentNodeToSeq(v))
366			case *pageMetaSource:
367				n2, err = handlePageMetaSource(v, nil, false)
368				if err != nil {
369					return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to create page from pageMetaSource %s: %w", s, err)
370				}
371				return
372			case *pageState:
373				// Nothing to do.
374				ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateNone
375				return v, ns, nil
376			case contentNodesMap:
377				ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateNone
378				for _, vv := range v {
379					switch m := vv.(type) {
380					case *pageMetaSource:
381						ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateUpdated
382						_, err := handlePageMetaSource(m, v, true)
383						if err != nil {
384							return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to create page from pageMetaSource %s: %w", s, err)
385						}
386					default:
387						// Nothing to do.
388					}
389				}
390	
391				return v, ns, nil
392	
393			default:
394				panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected type %T", n))
395			}
396		}

398		var unpackPageMetaSources func(n contentNode) contentNode
399		unpackPageMetaSources = func(n contentNode) contentNode {
400			switch nn := n.(type) {
401			case *pageState:
402				return nn.m.pageMetaSource
403			case contentNodesMap:
404				if len(nn) == 0 {
405					return nil
406				}
407				var iter contentNodeSeq = func(yield func(contentNode) bool) {
408					seen := map[*pageMetaSource]struct{}{}
409					for _, v := range nn {
410						vv := unpackPageMetaSources(v)
411						pms := vv.(*pageMetaSource)
412						if _, found := seen[pms]; !found {
413							if !yield(pms) {
414								return
415							}
416							seen[pms] = struct{}{}
417						}
418					}
419				}
420				return iter
421			case contentNodes:
422				if len(nn) == 0 {
423					return nil
424				}
425				var iter contentNodeSeq = func(yield func(contentNode) bool) {
426					seen := map[*pageMetaSource]struct{}{}
427					for _, v := range nn {
428						vv := unpackPageMetaSources(v)
429						pms := vv.(*pageMetaSource)
430						if _, found := seen[pms]; !found {
431							if !yield(pms) {
432								return
433							}
434							seen[pms] = struct{}{}
435						}
436					}
437				}
438				return iter
439			case *pageMetaSource:
440				return nn
441			default:
442				panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected type %T", n))
443			}
444		}

446		transformPages := func(s string, n contentNode, cascades *page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {
447			if a.h.isRebuild() {
448				cascadesPrevious := getCascades(h.previousPageTreesWalkContext, s)
449				h1, h2 := cascadesPrevious.SourceHash(), cascades.SourceHash()
450				if h1 != h2 {
451					// Force rebuild from the source.
452					n = unpackPageMetaSources(n)
453				}
454			}
455			if n == nil {
456				panic("nil node")
457			}
458			n2, ns, err = doTransformPages(s, n, cascades)
459	
460			return
461		}

463		transformPagesAndCreateMissingHome := func(s string, n contentNode, isResource bool, cascades *page.PageMatcherParamsConfigs) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {
464			if n == nil {
465				panic("nil node " + s)
466			}
467			level := strings.Count(s, "/")
468	
469			if s == "" {
470				a.seenHome = true
471			}
472	
473			if !isResource && s != "" && !a.seenHome {
474				a.seenHome = true
475				var homePages contentNode
476				homePages, ns, err = transformPages("", newHomePageMetaSource(), cascades)
477				if err != nil {
478					return
479				}
480				treePages.InsertRaw("", homePages)
481			}
482	
483			n2, ns, err = transformPages(s, n, cascades)
484			if err != nil || ns >= doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip {
485				return
486			}
487	
488			if n2 == nil {
489				ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip
490				return
491			}
492	
493			if isResource {
494				// Done.
495				return
496			}
497	
498			isTaxonomy := !a.h.getFirstTaxonomyConfig(s).IsZero()
499			isRootSection := !isTaxonomy && level == 1 && cnh.isBranchNode(n)
500			if !isTaxonomy {
501				p := cnh.PathInfo(n)
502				rootSection := p.Section()
503				_, err := a.seenRootSections.GetOrCreate(rootSection, func() (bool, error) {
504					if isRootSection {
505						return true, nil
506					}
507	
508					// Try to preserve the original casing if possible.
509					sectionUnnormalized := p.Unnormalized().Section()
510					rootSectionPath := a.h.Conf.PathParser().Parse(files.ComponentFolderContent, "/"+sectionUnnormalized+"/_index.md")
511	
512					// A regular page (e.g. content/s1.md) may share the same tree
513					// key as its section (both map to /s1). In that case the page
514					// itself already occupies the section root; creating a synthetic
515					// section on top of it would overwrite the real content.
516					if _, exists := treePages.GetRaw(rootSectionPath.Base()); exists {
517						return true, nil
518					}
519	
520					var rootSectionPages contentNode
521					rootSectionPages, _, err = transformPages(rootSectionPath.Base(), &pageMetaSource{
522						pathInfo:        rootSectionPath,
523						sitesMatrixBase: n2.(contentNodeForSites).siteVectors(),
524						pageConfigSource: &pagemeta.PageConfigEarly{
525							Kind: kinds.KindSection,
526						},
527					}, cascades)
528					if err != nil {
529						return true, err
530					}
531					treePages.InsertRaw(rootSectionPath.Base(), rootSectionPages)
532	
533					// Collect vectors from descendant pages to create section
534					// pages for all languages that have content in this section.
535					nm, replaced := contentNodeToContentNodesPage(rootSectionPages)
536					if replaced {
537						treePages.InsertRaw(rootSectionPath.Base(), nm)
538					}
539					missingVectors := sitesmatrix.Vectors{}
540					pw.WalkContext.AddEventListener("sitesmatrix", rootSectionPath.Base(),
541						func(e *doctree.Event[contentNode]) {
542							if cnh.isBranchNode(e.Source) && !a.h.getFirstTaxonomyConfig(e.Path).IsZero() {
543								return
544							}
545							n := e.Source
546							e.StopPropagation()
547							n.forEeachContentNode(
548								func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector, nn contentNode) bool {
549									if _, found := nm[vec]; !found {
550										missingVectors[vec] = struct{}{}
551									}
552									return true
553								})
554						},
555					)
556					pw.WalkContext.HooksPost().Push(
557						func() error {
558							if len(missingVectors) > 0 {
559								vec := missingVectors.VectorSample()
560								nm[vec] = &pageMetaSource{
561									pathInfo:            rootSectionPath,
562									sitesMatrixBase:     missingVectors,
563									sitesMatrixBaseOnly: true,
564									pageConfigSource: &pagemeta.PageConfigEarly{
565										Kind: kinds.KindSection,
566									},
567								}
568								_, _, err := transformPages(rootSectionPath.Base(), nm, cascades)
569								if err != nil {
570									return err
571								}
572							}
573							return nil
574						},
575					)
576	
577					return true, nil
578				})
579				if err != nil {
580					return nil, 0, err
581				}
582	
583			}
584	
585			const eventNameSitesMatrix = "sitesmatrix"
586	
587			if s == "" || isRootSection {
588	
589				// Every page needs a home and a root section (.FirstSection).
590				// We don't know yet what language, version, role combination that will
591				// be created below, so collect that information and create the missing pages
592				// on demand.
593				nm, replaced := contentNodeToContentNodesPage(n2)
594	
595				missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection := sitesmatrix.Vectors{}
596	
597				if s == "" {
598					// We need a complete set of home pages.
599					a.h.Conf.AllSitesMatrix().ForEachVector(func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector) bool {
600						if _, found := nm[vec]; !found {
601							missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection[vec] = struct{}{}
602						}
603						return true
604					})
605				} else {
606					pw.WalkContext.AddEventListener(eventNameSitesMatrix, s,
607						func(e *doctree.Event[contentNode]) {
608							n := e.Source
609							e.StopPropagation()
610							n.forEeachContentNode(
611								func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector, nn contentNode) bool {
612									if _, found := nm[vec]; !found {
613										missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection[vec] = struct{}{}
614									}
615									return true
616								})
617						},
618					)
619				}
620	
621				// We need to wait until after the walk to have a complete set.
622				pw.WalkContext.HooksPost().Push(
623					func() error {
624						if i := len(missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection); i > 0 {
625							// Pick one, the rest will be created later.
626							vec := missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection.VectorSample()
627	
628							kind := kinds.KindSection
629							if s == "" {
630								kind = kinds.KindHome
631							}
632	
633							pms := &pageMetaSource{
634								pathInfo:            cnh.PathInfo(n),
635								sitesMatrixBase:     missingVectorsForHomeOrRootSection,
636								sitesMatrixBaseOnly: true,
637								pageConfigSource: &pagemeta.PageConfigEarly{
638									Kind: kind,
639								},
640							}
641							nm[vec] = pms
642	
643							_, ns, err := transformPages(s, nm, cascades)
644							if err != nil {
645								return err
646							}
647							if ns == doctree.NodeTransformStateReplaced {
648								// Should not happen.
649								panic(fmt.Sprintf("expected no replacement for %q", s))
650							}
651	
652							if replaced {
653								pw.Tree.InsertRaw(s, nm)
654							}
655						}
656						return nil
657					},
658				)
659			}
660	
661			if s != "" {
662				rw.WalkContext.SendEvent(&doctree.Event[contentNode]{Source: n2, Path: s, Name: eventNameSitesMatrix})
663			}
664	
665			return
666		}

668		transformPagesAndCreateMissingStructuralNodes := func(s string, n contentNode, isResource bool) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {
669			cascades := getCascades(pw.WalkContext, s)
670			n2, ns, err = transformPagesAndCreateMissingHome(s, n, isResource, cascades)
671			if err != nil || ns >= doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip {
672				return
673			}
674			n2.forEeachContentNode(
675				func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector, nn contentNode) bool {
676					if ps, ok := nn.(*pageState); ok {
677						if ps.m.noLink() {
678							return true
679						}
680						for _, viewName := range getViews(vec) {
681							vals := types.ToStringSlicePreserveString(getParam(ps, viewName.plural, false))
682							if vals == nil {
683								continue
684							}
685							for _, v := range vals {
686								if v == "" {
687									continue
688								}
689								t := term{view: viewName, term: v}
690								a.seenTerms.WithWriteLock(func(m map[term]sitesmatrix.Vectors) error {

694											vec: struct{}{},

697									}

711		shouldSkipOrTerminate := func(s string) (ns doctree.NodeTransformState) {
712			owner := resourceOwnerInfo.n
713			if owner == nil {
714				return doctree.NodeTransformStateTerminate
715			}
716			if !cnh.isBranchNode(owner) {
717				return
718			}
719	
720			// A resourceKey always represents a filename with extension.
721			// A page key points to the logical path of a page, which when sourced from the filesystem
722			// may represent a directory (bundles) or a single content file (e.g. p1.md).
723			// So, to avoid any overlapping ambiguity, we start looking from the owning directory.
724			for {
725				s = path.Dir(s)
726				ownerKey, found := treePages.LongestPrefixRaw(s)
727				if !found {
728					return doctree.NodeTransformStateTerminate
729				}
730				if ownerKey == resourceOwnerInfo.s {
731					break
732				}
733	
734				if s != ownerKey && strings.HasPrefix(s, ownerKey) {
735					// Keep looking
736					continue
737				}
738	
739				// Stop walking downwards, someone else owns this resource.
740				rw.SkipPrefix(ownerKey + "/")

742			}
743			return
744		}

746		forEeachResourceOwnerPage := func(fn func(p *pageState) bool) bool {
747			switch nn := resourceOwnerInfo.n.(type) {
748			case *pageState:
749				return fn(nn)
750			case contentNodesMap:
751				for _, p := range nn {
752					if !fn(p.(*pageState)) {
753						return false
754					}
755				}
756			default:
757				panic(fmt.Sprintf("unknown type %T", nn))

759			return true
760		}

762		rw.Transform = func(s string, n contentNode) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {

772			ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateReplaced
773			n2 = nodes

775			forEeachResourceOwnerPage(

779						duplicateResourceFiles = p.s.ContentSpec.Converters.GetMarkupConfig().Goldmark.DuplicateResourceFiles

781	
782					if _, found := nodes[p.s.siteVector]; !found {
783						var rs *resourceSource
784						match := cnh.findContentNodeForSiteVector(p.s.siteVector, duplicateResourceFiles, cnh.contentNodeToSeq(n))

787						}

789						rs = match.(*resourceSource)

791						if rs != nil {

795								nodes[p.s.siteVector] = rs.clone().assignSiteVector(p.s.siteVector)
796							}
797						}
798					}
799					return true
800				},
801			)

803			// Duplicate resources across roles when owner pages share the same source.
804			// This ensures resources in a page bundle are available to all roles
805			// that the page spans, avoiding 404 errors in the rendered output.
806			if len(nodes) > 0 {
807				forEeachResourceOwnerPage(func(p *pageState) bool {
808					if _, found := nodes[p.s.siteVector]; found {
809						return true
810					}
811					// Find a resource from another role whose page shares
812					// the same pageMetaSource (i.e. same mount/content file).
813					forEeachResourceOwnerPage(func(donor *pageState) bool {
814						if donor.s.siteVector == p.s.siteVector {
815							return true
816						}
817						if donor.m.pageMetaSource != p.m.pageMetaSource {
818							return true
819						}
820						// Only clone across role differences, not language or version.
821						if donor.s.siteVector[sitesmatrix.Language] != p.s.siteVector[sitesmatrix.Language] ||
822							donor.s.siteVector[sitesmatrix.Version] != p.s.siteVector[sitesmatrix.Version] {
823							return true
824						}
825						if rs, ok := nodes[donor.s.siteVector]; ok {
826							nodes[p.s.siteVector] = rs.(*resourceSource).clone().assignSiteVector(p.s.siteVector)
827							return false
828						}
829						return true
830					})
831					return true
832				})
833			}
834	
835			return
836		}
837	
838		// Create  missing term pages.
839		pw.WalkContext.HooksPost().Push(
840			func() error {
841				for k, v := range a.seenTerms.All() {
842					viewTermKey := "/" + k.view.plural + "/" + k.term
843	
844					pi := a.h.Conf.PathParser().Parse(files.ComponentFolderContent, viewTermKey+"/_index.md")

847					n, found := pw.Tree.GetRaw(termKey)
848	
849					if found {
850						// Merge.

852							func(vec sitesmatrix.Vector, nn contentNode) bool {
853								delete(v, vec)
854								return true
855							},
856						)
857					}
858	
859					if len(v) > 0 {
860						p := &pageMetaSource{
861							pathInfo:        pi,
862							sitesMatrixBase: v,
863							pageConfigSource: &pagemeta.PageConfigEarly{
864								Kind: kinds.KindTerm,
865							},
866						}
867						var n2 contentNode = p
868						if found {
869							n2 = contentNodes{n, p}
870						}
871						n2, ns, err := transformPages(termKey, n2, getCascades(pw.WalkContext, termKey))
872						if err != nil {
873							return fmt.Errorf("failed to create term page %q: %w", termKey, err)
874						}
875	
876						switch ns {
877						case doctree.NodeTransformStateReplaced:
878							pw.Tree.InsertRaw(termKey, n2)
879						}
880	
881					}
882				}
883				return nil
884			},
885		)

887		pw.Transform = func(s string, n contentNode) (n2 contentNode, ns doctree.NodeTransformState, err error) {
888			n2, ns, err = transformPagesAndCreateMissingStructuralNodes(s, n, false)
889	
890			if err != nil || ns >= doctree.NodeTransformStateSkip {
891				return
892			}
893	
894			if iep, ok := n2.(contentNodeIsEmptyProvider); ok && iep.isEmpty() {
895				ns = doctree.NodeTransformStateDeleted
896			}
897	
898			if ns == doctree.NodeTransformStateDeleted {
899				return
900			}
901	
902			// Walk nested resources.
903			resourceOwnerInfo.s = s
904			resourceOwnerInfo.n = n2
905			rw = rw.WithPrefix(s + "/")
906			if err := rw.Walk(a.ctx); err != nil {
907				return nil, 0, err
908			}
909			const maxDepth = 3
910			if a.assembleSectionsInParallel && s != "" && depth < maxDepth && cnh.isBranchNode(n) && a.h.getFirstTaxonomyConfig(s).IsZero() {
911				// Handle this branch in its own goroutine.
912				pw.SkipPrefix(s + "/")
913				a.g.Go(func() error {
914					return a.doCreatePages(s, depth+1)
915				})
916	
917			}
918	
919			return
920		}
921	
922		pw.Handle = nil
923	
924		if err := pw.Walk(a.ctx); err != nil {
925			return err
926		}
927	
928		return nil
929	}

931	// Calculate and apply aggregate values to the page tree (e.g. dates).
932	func (sa *sitePagesAssembler) applyAggregates() error {
933		sectionPageCount := map[string]int{}
934	
935		pw := &doctree.NodeShiftTreeWalker[contentNode]{
936			Tree:        sa.s.pageMap.treePages,
937			LockType:    doctree.LockTypeRead,
938			WalkContext: &doctree.WalkContext[contentNode]{},
939		}
940		rw := pw.Extend()
941		rw.Tree = sa.s.pageMap.treeResources
942		sa.s.lastmod = time.Time{}
943		rebuild := sa.s.h.isRebuild()
944	
945		pw.Handle = func(keyPage string, n contentNode) (radix.WalkFlag, error) {
946			pageBundle := n.(*pageState)
947	
948			if pageBundle.Kind() == kinds.KindTerm {
949				// Delay this until they're created.
950				return radix.WalkContinue, nil
951			}
952	
953			if pageBundle.IsPage() {
954				rootSection := pageBundle.Section()
955				sectionPageCount[rootSection]++
956			}
957	
958			if rebuild {
959				if pageBundle.IsHome() || pageBundle.IsSection() {
960					oldDates := pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates
961	
962					// We need to wait until after the walk to determine if any of the dates have changed.
963					pw.WalkContext.HooksPost().Push(
964						func() error {
965							if oldDates != pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates {
966								sa.assembleChanges.Add(pageBundle)
967							}
968							return nil
969						},
970					)
971				}
972			}
973	
974			const eventName = "dates"
975			if cnh.isBranchNode(n) {
976				wasZeroDates := pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates.IsAllDatesZero()
977				if wasZeroDates || pageBundle.IsHome() {
978					pw.WalkContext.AddEventListener(eventName, keyPage, func(e *doctree.Event[contentNode]) {
979						sp, ok := e.Source.(*pageState)
980						if !ok {
981							return
982						}
983	
984						if wasZeroDates {
985							pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates.UpdateDateAndLastmodAndPublishDateIfAfter(sp.m.pageConfig.Dates)
986						}
987	
988						if pageBundle.IsHome() {
989							if pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates.Lastmod.After(pageBundle.s.lastmod) {
990								pageBundle.s.lastmod = pageBundle.m.pageConfig.Dates.Lastmod
991							}
992							if sp.m.pageConfig.Dates.Lastmod.After(pageBundle.s.lastmod) {
993								pageBundle.s.lastmod = sp.m.pageConfig.Dates.Lastmod
994							}
995						}
996					})
997				}
998			}
999	
1000			// Send the date info up the tree.
1001			pw.WalkContext.SendEvent(&doctree.Event[contentNode]{Source: n, Path: keyPage, Name: eventName})
1002	
1003			isBranch := cnh.isBranchNode(n)
1004			rw.Prefix = keyPage + "/"
1005			rw.IncludeRawFilter = func(s string, n contentNode) bool {
1006				// Only page nodes.
1007				return cnh.isPageNode(n)
1008			}
1009	
1010			rw.IncludeFilter = func(s string, n contentNode) bool {
1011				switch n.(type) {
1012				case *pageState:
1013					return true
1014				default:
1015					// We only want to handle page nodes here.
1016					return false
1017				}
1018			}
1019	
1020			rw.Handle = func(resourceKey string, n contentNode) (radix.WalkFlag, error) {
1021				if isBranch {
1022					ownerKey, _ := pw.Tree.LongestPrefix(resourceKey, false, nil)
1023					if ownerKey != keyPage {
1024						// Stop walking downwards, someone else owns this resource.
1025						rw.SkipPrefix(ownerKey + "/")
1026						return radix.WalkContinue, nil
1027					}
1028				}
1029				switch rs := n.(type) {
1030				case *pageState:
1031					relPath := rs.m.pathInfo.BaseRel(pageBundle.m.pathInfo)
1032					rs.m.resourcePath = relPath
1033				}
1034	
1035				return radix.WalkContinue, nil
1036			}
1037			if err := rw.Walk(sa.ctx); err != nil {
1038				return radix.WalkStop, err
1039			}
1040			return radix.WalkContinue, nil
1041		}
1042	
1043		if err := pw.Walk(sa.ctx); err != nil {
1044			return err
1045		}
1046	
1047		if err := pw.WalkContext.HandleEventsAndHooks(); err != nil {
1048			return err
1049		}
1050	
1051		if !sa.s.conf.C.IsMainSectionsSet() {
1052			var mainSection string
1053			var maxcount int
1054			for section, counter := range sectionPageCount {
1055				if section != "" && counter > maxcount {
1056					mainSection = section
1057					maxcount = counter
1058				}
1059			}
1060			sa.s.conf.C.SetMainSections([]string{mainSection})
1061	
1062		}
1063	
1064		return nil
1065	}

1068		walkContext := &doctree.WalkContext[contentNode]{}
1069	
1070		handlePlural := func(key string) error {

1092							doctree.LockTypeRead,

1094							func(ss string, wn *weightedContentNode) (bool, error) {

1097								return false, nil
1098							},

1101						}
1102					}

1106

1119				},
1120			}
1121	
1122			if err := pw.Walk(sa.ctx); err != nil {
1123				return err
1124			}
1125			return nil
1126		}
1127	
1128		for _, viewName := range sa.s.pageMap.cfg.taxonomyConfig.views {
1129			if err := handlePlural(viewName.pluralTreeKey); err != nil {
1130				return err
1131			}
1132		}
